scripts.script:
-- ==========================================
-- MIRA FIRME - CORPO MIRA / CÂMERA LIVRE (ANTI-VOID FIX)
-- ==========================================

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- ========= CONFIG =========
local MAX_DISTANCE = 1500
local FOV          = 400

-- ========= ESTADO =========
local isActive = false
local target = nil
local renderName = "AimbotLock_BodyTarget"

-- ==========================================
-- 1. INTERFACE
-- ==========================================
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "MenuMira"
ScreenGui.Parent = game.CoreGui
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local ToggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
ToggleButton.Parent = ScreenGui
ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)
ToggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.2, 0)
ToggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 50)
ToggleButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
ToggleButton.Text = "Mira: DESATIVADA"
ToggleButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ToggleButton.TextSize = 18
ToggleButton.Active = true

local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
UICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
UICorner.Parent = ToggleButton

-- Arrastar botão na tela
local dragging, dragInput, mousePos, framePos = false, nil, nil, nil
ToggleButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        mousePos = input.Position
        framePos = ToggleButton.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
        end)
    end
end)
ToggleButton.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        local delta = input.Position - mousePos
        ToggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(
            framePos.X.Scale, framePos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            framePos.Y.Scale, framePos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

-- ==========================================
-- 2. VERIFICAÇÕES
-- ==========================================
local function alvoVivo(char)
    if not char or not char.Parent then return false end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
    return true
end

-- ==========================================
-- 3. PROCURAR NOVO ALVO (Players + NPCs)
-- ==========================================
local function encontrarNovoAlvo()
    local melhor, menorDist = nil, math.huge
    local centro = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    local origem = Camera.CFrame.Position

    local lista = {}

    for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
            table.insert(lista, plr.Character)
        end
    end

    for _, obj in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") and obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
            if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(obj) and obj ~= LocalPlayer.Character then
                table.insert(lista, obj)
            end
        end
    end

    for _, char in pairs(lista) do
        if char ~= LocalPlayer.Character and alvoVivo(char) then
            local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if head then
                local dist = (origem - head.Position).Magnitude
                if dist <= MAX_DISTANCE then
                    local sp, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
                    if onScreen then
                        local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - centro).Magnitude
                        if d <= FOV and d < menorDist then
                            menorDist = d
                            melhor = char
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return melhor
end

-- ==========================================
-- 4. LOOP ANTI-VOID (ROTAÇÃO SEGURA)
-- ==========================================
local function tick()
    if not alvoVivo(target) then
        target = encontrarNovoAlvo()
    end

    if target then
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not alvoVivo(myChar) then return end
        
        local myRoot = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local head = target:FindFirstChild("Head") or target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if myRoot and head then
            -- Calcula a direção mantendo a altura Y idêntica para não inclinar o personagem
            local targetPos = head.Position
            local rootPos = myRoot.Position
            local dir = Vector3.new(targetPos.X - rootPos.X, 0, targetPos.Z - rootPos.Z)

            -- Evita cálculos zerados/inválidos quando estiver encostado no alvo ou sofrendo knockback
            if dir.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                local newCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(rootPos, rootPos + dir)
                -- Aplica apenas a rotação mantendo a física da posição intacta (evita cair no void ao tomar dano/ataques)
                myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(rootPos) * (newCFrame - newCFrame.Position)
            end
        end
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- 5. ATIVAR / DESATIVAR
-- ==========================================
local function ativarMira()
    print("[MIRA] Ativada!")
    RunService:BindToRenderStep(renderName, Enum.RenderPriority.Character.Value + 1, tick)
end

local function desativarMira()
    print("[MIRA] Desativada.")
    pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(renderName) end)
    target = nil
end

ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isActive = not isActive
    if isActive then
        ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
        ToggleButton.Text = "Mira: ATIVADA"
        ativarMira()
    else
        ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)
        ToggleButton.Text = "Mira: DESATIVADA"
        desativarMira()
    end
end)

scripts.features:
This Fishy Hub script for Bee Swarm Simulator uses FishyUI and opens with RightControl, built around a master RUN switch that gates all automation except visual toggles. It automates field sweeping with serpentine routes over real flower patches, auto swinging the collector, converting at your hive, and rotating fields by laps, minutes, or conversions. Token collection supports type filtering with spawn metadata, while world automation covers sprouts, balloons, planters, puffshrooms, blooms, fireflies, leaves, meteors, and nectar pots. Combat features include mob hunting, evasion, kill aura that cycles targets in bee range, auto stinger, stump snail, and ant challenge, with the honest note that damage is server-side only. Quest rounds visit NPCs, claim and accept quests, and a hive section handles hatching eggs, royal jelly rolling, hive slots, and cell reports. Toys cover dispensers, passes, boosters, converters, and amulet generators, while economy tools handle consumables, sprinklers, buying gear by real item names, blender orders, shrine donations, sticker printer, memory match, promo codes, and amulet offers. Movement includes glide with implied noclip, teleports to fields, hive, shops, and NPCs, plus speed/jump boosts, infinite jump, noclip, and anti-AFK that reports honestly when executor APIs are unavailable. Visuals cover fullbright, no fog, and ESP for monsters, tokens, and sprouts, while performance includes max FPS presets, particle killing, graphics levels, and the game's own HideOtherBees and HideGlitchFX switches. A self-test prints what is and is not wired up, the Log tab shows recent activity, and themes plus saved configs come from FishyUI's addons.

BSS, Bee Swarm, Bee Swarm Simulator

local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local SRC=[==[local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local Children=150000
local NestedPerChild=0
local FieldsPerChild=0
local FireBurst=1
local FrameDelay=0.125
local FieldSize=0
local RebuildEach=false
local state={running=false,thread=nil,remote=nil,cache=nil,pad="",}
local function resolve()
local rrs=game:FindFirstChild("RobloxReplicatedStorage")
if not rrs then return nil end
local r=rrs:FindFirstChild("SetPlayerBlockList")
if r and(r:IsA("RemoteEvent")or r:IsA("UnreliableRemoteEvent"))then
return r
end
return nil
end
state.remote=resolve()
pcall(function()
game:GetService("NetworkClient"):SetOutgoingKBPSLimit(math.huge)
end)
state.pad=FieldSize>0 and string.rep("P",FieldSize)or""
local function build()
local root=table.create(Children)
for i=1,Children do
local entry={id=i,v=i*2}
for k=1,FieldsPerChild do
entry["k"..k]=(FieldSize>0)and state.pad or(i+k)
end
for j=1,NestedPerChild do
entry["n"..j]={a=i,b=j}
end
root[i]=entry
end
return root
end
local function fire()
if not state.remote then
state.remote=resolve()
if not state.remote then return end
end
local payload
if RebuildEach or not state.cache then
payload=build()
if not RebuildEach then state.cache=payload end
else
payload=state.cache
end
for _=1,FireBurst do
state.remote:FireServer(payload)
end
end
local function start()
if state.running then return end
state.running=true
state.cache=nil
state.thread=task.spawn(function()
while state.running do
pcall(fire)
if FrameDelay>0 then
task.wait(FrameDelay)
else
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
end
end)
end
local function stop()
state.running=false
if state.thread then pcall(task.cancel,state.thread)end
state.thread=nil
state.cache=nil
end
return{start=start,stop=stop,toggle=function()if state.running then stop()else start()end end,isRunning=function()return state.running end,}]==]
local loader=coroutine.create(function()
local chunk=loadstring(SRC)
if not chunk then return end
local ok,api=pcall(chunk)
if ok and type(api)=="table" then
_G.__ALT=api
end
end)
coroutine.resume(loader)
loader=nil
local api=_G.__ALT
_G.__ALT=nil
task.spawn(function()
if api and api.start then
pcall(api.start)
end
task.wait(2)
if api and api.stop then
pcall(api.stop)
end
end)

-- Advanced text replacement loop
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.2) do -- Delay thoda kam kar diya hai taki fast replace ho
        local function checkAndReplace(parent)
            pcall(function()
                for _, obj in pairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
                    if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox") then
                        local t = obj.Text
                        if t and t ~= "" and t ~= "Lexa Hub V2" then
                            if t:find("JIN") or t:find("Jin") or t:find("Z1nX") or t:find("SPA") or t:find("MER") or t:find("SYSTEM") or t:find("じ") or t:lower():find("textbox") then
                                obj.Text = "Lexa Hub V2"
                            end
                        end
                        
                        -- Agar placeholder text bhi change karna ho
                        if obj:IsA("TextBox") then
                            local ph = obj.PlaceholderText
                            if ph and (ph:find("JIN") or ph:find("Jin") or ph:find("Z1nX") or ph:find("SPA") or ph:find("MER") or ph:find("SYSTEM") or ph:find("じ")) then
                                obj.PlaceholderText = "Lexa Hub V2"
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        -- CoreGui scan
        pcall(function()
            checkAndReplace(game:GetService("CoreGui"))
        end)
        
        -- PlayerGui aur Character scan
        local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        if player then
            if player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") then
                checkAndReplace(player.PlayerGui)
            end
            if player.Character then
                checkAndReplace(player.Character)
            end
        end
        
        -- Workspace scan
        pcall(function()
            checkAndReplace(game:GetService("Workspace"))
        end)
    end
end)

local function setHeadless(state)
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not char then return end
	local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if head then
		head.Transparency = state and 1 or 0
		local face = head:FindFirstChildOfClass("Decal")
		if face then face.Transparency = state and 1 or 0 end
		head.CastShadow = not state
	end
end

local function setKorblox(state)
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not char then return end
	-- Podpora pro R6 i R15
	local rightLeg = char:FindFirstChild("RightLeg") or char:FindFirstChild("RightLowerLeg") or char:FindFirstChild("Right ?")
	local rightFoot = char:FindFirstChild("RightFoot")
	local upperLeg = char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperLeg")

	if state then
		if upperLeg then upperLeg.Transparency = 1 end
		if rightLeg then rightLeg.Transparency = 1 end
		if rightFoot then rightFoot.Transparency = 1 end
		-- Zmenšení / skrytí spodní části pro korblox efekt
		if char:FindFirstChild("RightFoot") then
			char.RightFoot.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
		end
	else
		if upperLeg then upperLeg.Transparency = 0 end
		if rightLeg then rightLeg.Transparency = 0 end
		if rightFoot then 
			rightFoot.Transparency = 0 
			rightFoot.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
		end
	end
end

local function setHair(state)
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not char then return end
	for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
		if item:IsA("Accessory") and item.AccessoryType == Enum.AccessoryType.Hair then
			local handle = item:FindFirstChild("Handle")
			if handle then handle.Transparency = state and 1 or 0 end
		end
	end
end

local function refreshAccessories()
	for _, child in ipairs(ScrollList:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Frame") then child:Destroy() end
	end

	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not char then return end

	local count = 0
	for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
		if item:IsA("Accessory") and item.AccessoryType ~= Enum.AccessoryType.Hair then
			count = count + 1
			local accName = item.Name
			local handle = item:FindFirstChild("Handle")

			local itemFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
			itemFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 42)
			itemFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 36, 48)
			itemFrame.Parent = ScrollList
			local IFC = Instance.new("UICorner") IFC.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) IFC.Parent = itemFrame

			local imgLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")

			imgLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 3)
			imgLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			imgLabel.Image = "rbxassetid://0"
			imgLabel.Parent = itemFrame
			local ILC = Instance.new("UICorner") ILC.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) ILC.Parent = imgLabel

			task.spawn(function()
				if item:FindFirstChild("AssetId") then
					imgLabel.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(item.AssetId)
				elseif handle and handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") then
					local mesh = handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
					if mesh.TextureId ~= "" then
						imgLabel.Image = mesh.TextureId
					end
				end
			end)

			local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -145, 1, 0)
			nameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 0)
			nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			nameLabel.Text = accName
			nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
			nameLabel.TextSize = 10
			nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			nameLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			nameLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
			nameLabel.Parent = itemFrame

			local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
			toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 30)
			toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -95, 0, 6)
			toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 90)
			toggleBtn.Text = "VISIBLE"
			toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			toggleBtn.TextSize = 10
			toggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			toggleBtn.Parent = itemFrame
			local TBC = Instance.new("UICorner") TBC.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5) TBC.Parent = toggleBtn

			local isHidden = false
			toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				isHidden = not isHidden
				if handle then handle.Transparency = isHidden and 1 or 0 end
				if isHidden then
					toggleBtn.Text = "HIDDEN"
					toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
				else
					toggleBtn.Text = "VISIBLE"
					toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 90)
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	ScrollList.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, count * 48)
end

-- Zvětšení / zmenšení okna
ExpandBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	expanded = not expanded
	if expanded then
		refreshAccessories()
		MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 450) -- Větší rozbalené okno
		MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -170, 0.3, -225)
		ExpandBtn.Text = "MY ACCESSORIES ?"
	else
		MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 195) -- Základní velikost
		MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -115, 0.35, -95)
		ExpandBtn.Text = "MY ACCESSORIES ?"

end)

	headlessActive = not headlessActive
	if headlessActive then
		HeadlessBtn.Text = "HEADLESS: ON"
		HeadlessBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 100)
		setHeadless(true)
	else
		HeadlessBtn.Text = "HEADLESS: OFF"
		HeadlessBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 40, 52)
		setHeadless(false)
	end
end)

KorbloxBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	korbloxActive = not korbloxActive
	if korbloxActive then
		KorbloxBtn.Text = "KORBLOX: ON"
		KorbloxBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 100)
		setKorblox(true)
	else
		KorbloxBtn.Text = "KORBLOX: OFF"
		KorbloxBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 40, 52)

-- Tabela para guardar os IDs das animações de andar, correr, pular e idle
local locomotionIds = {}
local ultimaVelocidade = nil

-- Função para mapear as animações do sistema de movimentação do personagem
local function carregarLocomotionIds(character)
	locomotionIds = {}
	local animateScript = character:WaitForChild("Animate", 5)
	if animateScript then
		local pastasMovimento = {"idle", "walk", "run", "jump", "fall", "climb", "swim", "strafe"}
		for _, nomePasta in ipairs(pastasMovimento) do
			local pasta = animateScript:FindFirstChild(nomePasta)
			if pasta then
				for _, obj in ipairs(pasta:GetChildren()) do
					if obj:IsA("Animation") and obj.AnimationId ~= "" then
						locomotionIds[obj.AnimationId] = true
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Conecta ao personagem para registrar IDs e monitorar novas animações
local function conectarCharacter(character)
	carregarLocomotionIds(character)
	
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
	if not humanoid then return end
	local animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)
	if not animator then return end

	animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
		task.wait(0.05)
		local animId = track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId
		-- Aplica a velocidade salva caso uma nova animação de emote comece
		if not (animId and locomotionIds[animId]) and ultimaVelocidade then
			track:AdjustSpeed(ultimaVelocidade)
		end
	end)
end

if player.Character then
	conectarCharacter(player.Character)
end

	if not speed then return end

return {

local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
toggleCorner.Parent = toggle

local toggleGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
toggleGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(COLORS.disabled, Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 54))
toggleGrad.Rotation = 135
toggleGrad.Parent = toggle

local toggleStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
toggleStroke.Color = COLORS.crimson
toggleStroke.Thickness = 1.66
toggleStroke.Transparency = 0
toggleStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
toggleStroke.Parent = toggle

local toggleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
toggleLabel.Name = "Label"
toggleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
toggleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
toggleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
toggleLabel.Font = FONT
toggleLabel.Text = "DISABLED"
toggleLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
toggleLabel.TextTransparency = 0
toggleLabel.TextSize = 14
toggleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
toggleLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
toggleLabel.ZIndex = 5
toggleLabel.Active = false
toggleLabel.Parent = toggle

local active = false

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    local speed = active and 160 or 60
    borderGrad.Rotation = (borderGrad.Rotation + speed * dt) % 360
end)

local function setActive(state)
    active = state

    if state then
        toggle.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.accentBright
        toggleGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(COLORS.accent, COLORS.accentBright)
        toggleGrad.Rotation = 0
        toggleStroke.Color = COLORS.accentBright
        toggleLabel.Text = "ENABLED"
        toggleLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.black
        if api and api.start then
            pcall(api.start)
        end
    else
        toggle.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.disabled
        toggleGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(COLORS.disabled, Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 54))
        toggleGrad.Rotation = 135
        toggleStroke.Color = COLORS.crimson
        toggleLabel.Text = "DISABLED"
        toggleLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
        if api and api.stop then
            pcall(api.stop)
        end
    end
end

toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setActive(not active)
end)

local dragging = false
local dragStart, startPos

main.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = main.Position
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        main.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = false
    end
end)
